I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message. I confirmed both facts: the Greywater rollout at Marrow Fieldworks is due 9 October, and the Juniper rollout at Tansley Parcel is 131 seats. I also pointed out that 9 October was ten days ago and asked them to tell me if the date has moved.

There's nowhere for me to save these facts, so I only acknowledged them. Neither one is a finance figure, so they're fine to post in the channel.
